appName.description: Extension name — keep identical across locales (brand)

appDesc.message: Detect if a webpage is using Client-Side Rendering or Server-Side Rendering
appDesc.description: Extension description shown on the extensions page and Chrome Web Store (max 132 chars)

analyzing.description: Popup/panel status while the analysis runs

analyzePage.description: Button shown when automatic analysis is turned off

rerun.description: Tooltip on the re-run icon button

analyzeAgain.description: DevTools panel button that re-runs the analysis

settings.description: Tooltip on the settings icon button

confidence.description: Caption under the confidence dial; lowercase

fromServer.description: Legend for the share of text that came from the server

fromJavaScript.description: Legend for the share of text added by scripts

detectedStack.description: Card title listing detected frameworks and generators

whyThisVerdict.description: Card title above the strongest signals

scoredEvidence.description: Card title for signals that changed the score

context.description: Card title for signals that did not change the score

transport.description: Card title for CDN and cache header details

regions.description: Card title for the per-region server/client breakdown

tabSignals.description: Tab label for the evidence list

tabDiff.description: Tab label for the region breakdown

devToolsPanel.description: Name of the DevTools panel feature

copySummary.description: Button that copies a one-line summary

copied.description: Transient button label after a successful copy

copyFailed.description: Transient button label after a failed copy

historyEmpty.message: Analyzed pages will be listed here.
historyEmpty.description: Empty state for the history tab

analysisFailed.description: Error heading when analysis did not return a result

cannotAccess.description: Error heading when the page cannot be scripted

giveFeedback.description: Footer link to the feedback form; keep it short

themeAuto.description: Theme option that follows the operating system

unlimited.description: History limit option meaning no cap

pinNotPinned.description: Welcome page status: the extension is not pinned yet

pinPinned.description: Welcome page status: the extension is pinned

shortcutUnset.description: Shown when no keyboard shortcut is assigned
